source.identity_basis: Catalogue and title/imprint inspection recorded in the acquisition review; exact local scan digest, byte count and PDF count rechecked during package qualification.

page_convention: All ranges are inclusive and PDF pages are one-based. Printed-to-PDF offsets are stated only for the bounded passages, not assumed across the volume.

continuous_main_text_reads.scope: Main text read directly from page images; bounded English comparison, not whole-volume critical collation.

continuous_main_text_reads.topic: Power, choice and transition to wisdom
continuous_main_text_reads.scope: Full-page direct visual reading including all visible apparatus.
Full-page direct visual reading including all visible apparatus; printed p. 450 included as closure and next-section context.
Direct visual reading of the local printed passage, surrounding argument and edition apparatus.

overlap_note: PDF pp. 510 and 550 occur in adjacent reading scopes and are counted once in the 78-page union.

separately_bounded_context_reads.basis: Direct visual inspection reported in the complete bounded reading receipts; not a continuous reading of the whole introduction or apparatus.

edition_and_manuscript_distinction.inspected_object: Modern printed edition scan, not an original manuscript or autograph.
edition_and_manuscript_distinction.sad: The editor identifies ص as a Dār al-Kutub al-Miṣriyya manuscript and reports the added block from printed pp. 399–450 as unique to it among the consulted witnesses.
edition_and_manuscript_distinction.kaf: The editor identifies ك as the 1329 AH Cairo Kurdistan Scientific Press printed collection, volume 5; it is a printed edition, not a manuscript.
edition_and_manuscript_distinction.basis_change: The editor reports using ص through its termination at printed p. 450, then changing the base to printed ك.
edition_and_manuscript_distinction.qualification: These are verified reports of the modern printed apparatus, including its corrections and variants. Neither original witness was independently inspected or collated here.

six_supplied_pdf_coverage_relation.limit: The additional Arabic scan is separate. Its 938-page length is not credited as reading and is not added to the six-PDF 1,393-page coverage total. Later bounded English comparisons do not alter that record or its frozen visual snapshot.

limits: No whole-938-page reading or whole-volume critical collation claim.
No original-manuscript inspection, autograph authentication or independent collation of the 1329 printed witness.
No independent direct collation of the Rushd 2001 edition, al-Razi's al-Arbaʿin, or every cited work.
Reading coverage and source hashes do not establish philosophical truth, historical novelty or final release clearance.
This package includes bibliographical and scope metadata only; no source passage, translation extract, PDF, OCR text or page image is redistributed.
